test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Statements:

1. All books are papers.

2. All papers are trees.

Conclusions:

1. All books are trees.

2. Some trees are books
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2986e32c914c8a22f23239aecef325eb40bcefaf0dcf5faa2047288c7f2c821e.png] 

Conclusions:

1. All books are trees → Follow (As all books are papers and all papers are trees. As whole books comes in papers which whole comes in trees, therefore it is true.)

2. Some trees are books → **F**ollow (As all books are papers and all papers are trees. As whole books comes in papers which whole comes in trees, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Both I and II follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
